description: This source file is a shell script used for device-specific upgrade and recovery operations related to Buffalo routers with MediaTek MT7622 chipset. It defines behaviors for device upgrade procedures, checks for valid images, handles UBI and TRX formatted images, and contains device-specific magic number definitions and upgrade logic.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the integrity and compatibility of the firmware image for the specific Buffalo device, checking TRX magic, tar archive validity, and kernel size consistency.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process for a TRX + UBI formatted image, including detaching UBI, erasing the firmware partition, and writing the new image.

methods.name: buffalo_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines whether the firmware image is TRX + UBI or standard, and calls the appropriate upgrade function.
